reason: The hypothesis directly restates the approach and findings of P10/P13/P18/P22/P24/P27, which already designed and tested a low-density Hf-Nb-Ta-Ti-Zr alloy by reducing Ta and Hf content, achieving lower density with similar strength. The proposed intervention (substituting Ta with Nb) and the predicted outcome (density reduction with strength retention) are essentially the same as the prior work, with only a minor compositional adjustment (50% Ta replacement instead of 75% reduction) and no new mechanism or integration of different sources.
